new entry "Target_Spell"
type "SpellData"
data "SpellType" "Target"
data "SpellProperties" "ApplyStatus(Target_Status,100,2)"
data "TargetConditions" "Character() and not Dead()"
data "UseCosts" "ActionPoint:1;SpellSlotsGroup:1:1:1"

new entry "Target_Spell_Upcast"
type "SpellData"
using "Target_Spell"
data "RootSpellID" "Target_Spell"
